equipment: Your equipment is the things that you use to do a job or sport.
Soccer is a popular game because you need very little equipment to play--just a ball and an open space.
equal: If two things are equal, they are the same in shape, size, or number.
The number of people inside of the store is equal to the number of people outside of the store.
Someone who has the same rights as somebody else.
I'm your teacher, not your equal.
If x equals y, x and y have the same value.
equation: An equation is a mathematical statement in which both sides are of equal value.
Find x, in the equation x + 2y = 3y.
; An equation is how everything works together to create a situation.
Money plays a big part in the political equation.
The equation of x with y, is the act of thinking about them as the same or as belonging together.
The equation of women with maids and cooks must stop.
equip: If you equip a person or a place, you give them equipment.
We equipped the buses with blankets and pillows and high-tech stereo headphones and telephones.
If you equip someone with skills or knowledge, you teach it to them.
This program equips students with the skills they need to succeed in college.
equivalent: If two things are equivalent, they are of equal value or acceptability.
Dolphins have very large brains, roughly equivalent to the size of a human brain.
An equivalent is something of equal value of acceptability.
Living in Thailand costs the equivalent of just £10 per day.
equality: The state of being equal, of having the same value.
The equal treatment of all people even if they are different.
equestrian: Related to horseback riding or horseback riders.
She will compete in a horse show to test her equestrian skills.
Riding on the back of a horse.
The equestrian soldiers rode down the hill into the battle.
Showing a person sitting on the back of a horse.
Children like to play among the metal legs of the equestrian statue in the park.
The equestrian brushed his horse before the race.
equator: The equator is the line that separates the Northern Hemisphere and Southern Hemisphere equally. A Latin word for "even-maker", since the days and nights are even throughout the year.
The climate around the equator is very humid.
equilibrium: When something is at equilibrium, it is balanced and different types of influences are the same, hence having no net change.
The population of the ants in this area has reached an equilibrium.
When an object is at equilibrium, it is at rest or continuous motion and all the forces acting on it cancels out to become zero.
When a system is in equilibrium, the rates of the forward and backward reactions are the same, hence causing no change in the concentration of the reactants and products.
When a weak acid is added into water, an equilibrium mixture is obtained.
equanimity: If someone has equanimity, they are calm even in difficult situations.
We will need a leader of true equanimity to bring us through the war.
equisized: If something is equisized, its exactly equal in size. When you say equisized, it means its components or constituents don't have a plurality or majority, nor a minority.
The six varieties of fruit in the basket had an equisized number of each inside.
equivocate: If a person equivocates, they speak using double meaning so as to confuse or mislead people.
equivocal: If a word is equivocal, it has two or more equally applicable meanings.
equivalence: If there is equivalence between things, they are equal.
equate: If you equate two things, you consider them to be equal.
equalize: If you equalize A, you make it equal with B.
equalise: If you equalise A, you make it equal with B.
equally: If something is equally distributed, it is distributed into equal parts.
equidistant: If something is equidistant from 2 or more points, it is located at a position that is the same distance from those points.
The centre of the circle is equidistant from all points on its circumference.
equitable: If a situation or decision is equitable, it is fair and balanced.
Nobody got exactly what they wanted, but the judge made an equitable decision.
equinox: An equinox is a time in the year when the length of the day and the night are equal.
Equinox happens in March and September.
